hostname.description: The XMPP component's domain (e.g. irc.example.org) — a site value; biboumi refuses an empty one.

password.description: The component secret shared with the XMPP server — a site value; biboumi refuses an empty one.

xmpp_server_ip.description: IP address of the XMPP server to which biboumi connects.

port.description: The port on which the XMPP component listens for incoming connections (typically 5347 for XMPP components).

admin.description: XMPP JID (bare or full) of the service administrator. Receives operational notices and errors.

realname_customization.description: Allow per-user customization of the realname sent to IRC servers.

realname_from_jid.description: Use the JID (instead of hostname) to generate the realname if realname_customization=true.

log_file.description: Log to this file instead of standard output (the journal). Its directory must exist and be writable by _biboumi — the package creates none.

ca_file.description: Absolute path to the CA certificate file (PEM format). Used for TLS verification. Maps to tls_cert in schema.

outgoing_bind.description: Local IP address to bind to for outgoing IRC connections.

log_level.description: Verbosity of biboumi's log: 0 debug, 1 info, 2 warning, 3 error.
